name: aosp-academy WireGuard tunnel
description: Brings up the aosp-academy WireGuard tunnel (wg0) on the stock system at boot, from /data/adb/aospacademy-wg (aosp-academy stock tunnel puts wg and the config there), so adb reaches the phone over the tunnel on stock as on the image. Without that config it does nothing. Disable and reboot to stop it.
